summary_en: DAI-ICHI CUTTER KOGYO executed the purchase of 700,000 shares at 1,300 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on October 21, 2026, representing 5.8% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. This execution is part of the 7 million share buyback authorization (up to 1 billion yen) announced on August 14, 2026.
title_en: Notice of share acquisition via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 20, 2026, DAI-ICHI CUTTER KOGYO announced the execution of a share buyback through off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3). The company purchased exactly 700,000 ordinary shares at a fixed price of 1,300 yen per share on October 21, 2026 at 8:45 a.m. Tokyo time, with the purchase order confined to that single trading session. The total acquisition amount was approximately 910 million yen, representing 5.8% of issued shares excluding treasury stock.

This block execution is part of the share repurchase authorization program announced on August 14, 2026, which authorized the acquisition of up to 700,000 shares with a maximum outlay of 1 billion yen. The board of directors determined the acquisition method and fixed price for this specific execution on October 20, 2026. No additional changes to the authorized buyback program were announced, and the company retained the right to adjust or suspend the purchase based on market conditions.
